dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible as irregular, high-contrast closed loops and C-shaped patterns with sharp pixel intensity transitions from light-colored borders to dark centers. The perimeter geometry is highly crenulated with a distinct light-intensity halo effect around dark focal areas.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily along the lower lateral line and near the transition zone between dorsal and ventral regions, characterized by solid luminance without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal-mid annuli form a non-equilateral quadrilateral, with the longest axis oriented parallel to the spinal column.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive linear red-orange high-intensity mark located near the lower orbital region of the head.
